name: fig09_free_energy_hawking_page
caption: Free energy of Schwarzschild-AdS black holes (large branch solid, small branch dashed) compared with thermal AdS (F = 0). Black holes exist only above T_min = sqrt(3)/(2 pi L); the large branch crosses F = 0 at T_HP = 1/(pi L) (r_+ = L), reproducing the Hawking-Page transition (Hawking and Page 1983). Asymptotically flat Schwarzschild has F = M/2 > 0 at all temperatures and no preferred equilibrium (negative heat capacity).
